name: kiro-fabric-dev
description: Develop and verify the Kiro Fabric repository with repository steering and an explicit Fabric MCP boundary.
prompt: Follow the bound repository steering. Use native tools for ordinary repository work. Use @fabric/fabric_exec only for checked programmable composition, provider fan-out, Fabric state or memory, or configured MCP federation. Treat denial, timeout, cancellation, and indeterminate effects as failures.
